metadata.description: TALXIS plugins for coding agents — build Power Platform apps in a local-first monorepo with the TALXIS CLI (txc): scaffold, build, validate, and deploy deterministically.

plugins.name: implement
plugins.description: Build TALXIS / Power Platform apps in a local-first monorepo: scaffold components with the TALXIS CLI (txc), validate with dotnet build, deploy as Package Deployer packages. Use when creating a new TALXIS project or working on an existing one.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Data lifecycle for TALXIS / Power Platform / Dataverse projects: test and reference data kept as source (CMT packages with stable GUIDs), volume-based routing between throwaway records and packaged seed data, and export round-trips through the TALXIS CLI (txc). Use when provisioning, seeding, or migrating data in a TALXIS project.
